title: Unsupervised Tool Evolution for Coding Agents in Data-Lake Analytics

summary: Coding agents can answer analytical questions over a data lake by discovering, cleaning, and joining the relevant data. However, they discard this work after each question and redo it from scratch for the next one.
takeaways: We propose TEAL (Tool Evolution for Analytics over data Lakes), which evolves a library of tools and usage skills for a given Worker agent without labels.
Two agents propose tools from complementary evidence, an Explorer from the data lake itself and a Critic from Worker trajectories.
We evaluate on KramaBench and LakeQA with four Worker LLMs under step budgets, which cap the number of steps the Worker may take per question.
